wedding.title: Wedding
wedding.location: The Crystal Suite, The Greyhound Hotel, 3 London Road, Slough, Berkshire SL3 7HR

messages.accepted: Thank you for your RSVP. We look forward to celebrating with you — see you soon.
messages.declined: Thank you for your RSVP. We understand and hope to see you at a future function.
messages.deadlinePassed: The RSVP deadline has passed. You can skip RSVP here and contact the couple directly if needed.

fallback.title: Welcome & Nadaswaram
fallback.description: Guests are welcomed with traditional music as the families gather.

fallback.title: Ganapathi Pooja
fallback.description: Prayers to Lord Ganesha for an auspicious beginning.

fallback.title: Kasi Yatra
fallback.description: The groom sets off on his symbolic pilgrimage before the bride’s father persuades him to return.

fallback.title: Maalai Maatral
fallback.description: Exchange of garlands as the couple formally accept each other.

fallback.title: Oonjal
fallback.description: The couple are seated on the swing and blessed with songs and coloured rice.

fallback.title: Kanyadaanam
fallback.description: The bride’s parents give her hand in marriage.

fallback.title: Thaali Kattu · Muhurtham
fallback.description: The groom ties the thaali as the drums rise — the sacred moment of marriage.

fallback.title: Saptapadi & Ammi Midithal
fallback.description: Seven steps around the fire and the stepping on the grinding stone.

fallback.title: Aseervatham & Lunch
fallback.description: Blessings from elders followed by a traditional vegetarian feast.

fallback.title: Photographs & Celebrations
fallback.description: Join the couple for photos, music and dancing until 6:00 pm.
